tasks.title: Extract classified units, sections and raw resources
tasks.goal: Expose source content without inventing facts in ordinary data.
steps: Consume M-06-A descriptor before selecting parser/fragment rules.
Reuse Vibe facts only for declared specs; resolve CommonMark exports and raw XML/opaque resources separately.
Return encoding, representation recipe and exact span basis; optional structured-view failure does not prevent raw retrieval.
Implement a shared SpecDoc IR node selector for exact section, fact (paragraph/list/table cell), dotted path and documentation pNN anchors; use the same selector for read_spec and compiler #embed.
Return just the selected subtree or direct section blocks when children=false; build an outline with per-node byte sizes and heading chain without a prebuilt specmap.
Index permitted table-cell facts (and quote/header facts only where the dictionary permits) in canonical specmap with MD/XML parity.
positive_cases: CommonMark sections retain literal Vibe annotations; invalid XML-data raw bytes remain retrievable.
Fixture with nested Solution section and table/list facts selects the exact node; #embed and read_spec produce the same selected IR.
Specmap indexes CC-A-4-1 and CC-A-4-2 from Markdown table cells and XML td elements, with explain success.
negative_cases: Same-stem ordinary resources are not spec collisions; projected XML locations are not raw positions.
Ambiguous dotted path and unknown anchor refuse with candidates, never choose a nearby node.
Inline-code marker quotes do not mint table-cell facts.

tasks.title: Publish generated source-query service and adapters
tasks.goal: Make canonical service, CLI and MCP share the same validated contract.
steps: Use M-16-C service/context carriers and register source request/result/error schemas.
Generate types using cargo xtask codegen, then implement thin CLI/MCP adapters.
Bind expected resolution/source/document hashes and chunk cursors to one observation; validate errors as well as successes.
Expose read_spec MCP and vibe spec read CLI through the same selected-source resolver as read_doc, with exact versionless installed selection and no untrusted root.
Return canonical address, dictionary/status, heading chain, selected/full byte sizes, materialized slot path and line range; support md/xml, children=false and outline.
Resolve source-neutral specmap locators against the actual slot file at query time; refuse stale/unconverted or ambiguous location instead of reporting source coordinates as slot coordinates.
positive_cases: Equivalent requests return equal semantic results and proof levels across surfaces.
Markdown and XML consumer slots return the same semantic Solution/fact selection and each reports its own actual extension and line range.
CLI and MCP success/error payloads agree for whole document, nested section, table fact and outline.
negative_cases: Unknown fields/epochs, arbitrary MCP root and stale cursor or expectation refuse before effects.
Unknown package/document/anchor return typed candidate-bearing errors; no hidden write or unbounded whole-document fallback for a selected node.
